name: HavenBags - Bag Preview
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: ArturoAtomplay
description: HavenBagsPreview is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows you to view the contents of your HavenBags bags directly in the inventory tooltip, just like a bundle or shulker preview. Save time and manage your bags more efficiently!
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
evidence: Not run: Java did not start.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
